positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Analyze, Design, Develop, Deploy, Debug and Support two Flex/ActionScript Video Player for VOD and Live Event playback as well as Develop Administration Profile and Reporting Modules for our Video Solution for our Enterprise Business clients and partners. The release version name of our product is "Show and Share", our team is currently working on the release of the next generation video solution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Analyze, Design and Develop Web Application targeted for Disney Clients called FHBP. This application helps the clients manage and keep track of the recalled products in their field offices all over the world. The technologies used in this product where Flex, HTML, Javascript and CSS with the help of YUI and JQuery libraries.
